title: Logitech M185 Wireless Mouse, 2.4GHz, USB Mini Receiver Included
categoryName: Computers/Tablets & Networking:Keyboards, Mice & Pointers:Mice, Trackballs & Touchpads
descriptionText: The Logitech M185 Wireless Mouse is a sleek and efficient device that offers a maximum DPI of 1000 for precise navigation. With a plug-and-play feature, this mouse is easy to use straight out of the box. The black color and minimalist design make it a versatile accessory for any computer setup. The wireless connectivity via 2.4GHz technology and the inclusion of a USB mini receiver ensure seamless and convenient use. With optical tracking method and three buttons, the Logitech M185 is a reliable and user-friendly option for everyday computing needs.
